variants.change: P1 breakout admission only: prior completed M1 high-low >= 600000 micro and 10*range >= 7*modeled ATR14
variants.unknown_bar_policy: require exactly the immediately prior minute; missing, stale, current, or invalid ATR/bar is unknown and rejects the P1 gate

variants.change: initial-ticket BE/trail reference is that initial OPEN command's BUY Ask or SELL Bid
variants.unsupported_mapping: native partial fill or retry fails closed with a preserved run failure; no actual deal injection

shared_model.initial_state: flat, no pending order, shock unlocked; unverified model counterfactual
shared_model.execution: ordered quote events, market first strictly later row and millisecond after command+100ms, fullfill; STOP typed ACK then later row and millisecond at trigger; zero modeled slippage
shared_model.accounting: native fills; independent ledger; open fee reserved, exit fee realized
shared_model.source_clocks: assumed UTC event time only; release, ingestion, availability, actual cutoff, timezone and DST unknown
shared_model.windows: one continuous source stream per comparison; common C inclusive and EOF separately; no state reset at C
